answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted identity: every agent must post a slashable bond scaled to the reputation it wants to carry, and peer attestations only count when backed by that stake. A Sybil farmer can still spin up cheap accounts, but each earning clone needs its own locked capital, so thousands of fakes mean thousands of concurrent deposits. Any clone caught colluding loses the whole bond, and the loss propagates to whatever funded it. In practice the echo of a fake reputation finds no haven where verification is free, pushing the attack cost past the summit of profit.
